_doc: One fixed input per calculator for the hourly live check (S117 WP-1, I297). Each expect string is a value from an OUTSIDE source named in 'source': an HMRC worked example or test routine, a statutory rule worked by hand from GOV.UK figures, or an independent model (a brute-force sweep, a closed form). Never the engine, the registry or the page (repo CLAUDE.md, figures rule). Field ids are the live page's element ids; the runner fills them, submits the form (requestSubmit) and reads the result container's text. A calculator with 'form': null is read after load with no submit. 'expect_pattern' is a regular expression the result text must match. 'result_timeout' is milliseconds.

calculators.source: VATA 1994 s2(1) standard rate 20% (GOV.UK, VAT rates): net 100.00, VAT 100 x 20% = 20.00, gross 120.00, by hand.

First principles on GOV.UK 2026/27 rUK rates, no Employment Allowance: salary 5,000 = secondary threshold, so employer and employee NI 0; CT 19% x (50,000 - 5,000) = 8,550; dividends 36,450; PA 12,570 covers the salary and 7,570 of dividends; 28,880 taxable less 500 allowance = 28,380 x 10.75% = 3,050.85; take-home 5,000 + 36,450 - 3,050.85 = 38,399.15.

SSCR 2001 reg 100 annual maximum by hand (matches PolicyEngine): Class 1 main 17,430 x 8% = 1,394.40; steps 2 to 8 give a Class 4 maximum of 927.00 against 1,045.80 billed. Income tax on the profit stacked on the salary, GOV.UK 2026/27 rates by hand.

TCGA 1992 s104 pooling by hand: (5,000 + 7,000) / 2,000 shares = 6.00 a share; 1,000 sold for 10,000 less 6,000 cost = gain 4,000; less the 3,000 annual exempt amount = 1,000 x 18% (basic rate, GOV.UK CGT rates 2026/27) = 180.00.

By hand: the relief fraction rule of HMRC Helpsheet HS283 (Private Residence Relief): 183 of 192 months are relieved (the final 9 months fall inside them), so 9/192 of the gain is chargeable; (100,000 x 9/192 - 3,000 annual exempt amount) x 24% (higher rate, GOV.UK CGT rates 2026/27, income 60,000) = (4,687.50 - 3,000) x 24% = 405.00.
IHTA 1984 s7 and Sch 1 (GOV.UK, Inheritance Tax): a 1,000,000 estate with no descendants gets the 325,000 nil-rate band only; (1,000,000 - 325,000) x 40% = 270,000, by hand.

HMRC PAYE emergency tax routine (PAYErout v24.0), code 1257L month 1, on the 15,000 taxable slice of a 20,000 UFPLS, worked by hand: free pay 2 x 416.67 + 214.92 = 1,048.26 (4.3.1), Tn = 13,951, threshold tax 42,516 / 12 = 3,543.0000 (Definition 11, Appendix A), tax 3,543.0000 + (13,951 - 10,428.3333) x 45% = 5,128.2000, so 5,128.20 (I458, D281: was 5,128.19). The same working is in test-scripts/engine-oracle/test_emergency_tax.js ('rUK 15,000 taxable/mo' and 'Month 1: 15,000 withholds').
Independent brute-force sweep of every salary pound on GOV.UK 2026/27 rates (test_salary_dividend.js section E, 'marginal band, no allowance'): optimal salary 12,570, take-home 55,764.87.

GOV.UK 2026/27 rates (Income Tax bands, self-employed NI, employer NI, Corporation Tax with marginal relief, dividend tax) by hand, for 80,000 of profit in England with no other income. Sole trader: Income Tax 37,700 x 20% + 29,730 x 40% = 19,432; Class 4 37,700 x 6% + 29,730 x 2% = 2,856.60; take-home 57,711.40. Company, all taken out, salary 12,570: employer NI 7,570 x 15% = 1,135.50; Corporation Tax on 66,294.50 = 16,573.63 - 3/200 x 183,705.50 = 13,818.04; dividends 52,476.46 taxed 37,200 x 10.75% + 14,776.46 x 35.75% = 9,281.58 after the 500 allowance; take-home 12,570 + 52,476.46 - 9,281.58 = 55,764.88.
Scottish income tax rates and bands 2026/27 (Scottish Government, GOV.SCOT) by hand: 3,662 x 21% + 338 x 42% = 910.98 on the 5,000 side income.

GOV.UK voluntary National Insurance rates and the full new State Pension, by hand: 35 - 33 = 2 years add pension; the cheapest are 2024/25 (17.45 x 52 = 907.40) and 2025/26 (17.75 x 52 = 923.00) = 1,830.40; the other 5 at 18.40 x 52 = 956.80 each = 4,784.00, not counted.
GOV.UK CGT rates 2026/27 by hand: income exactly 50,270 leaves no basic-rate band, so (10,000 - 3,000) x 24% = 1,680.00. CGT is UK-wide (TCGA 1992 s1J(6)).
By hand: FIRE number 28,000 / 4% = 700,000; normal minimum pension age 57 for this cohort (FA 2022 s10) - 45 = a 12-year bridge x 28,000 = 336,000.

Closed form by hand (I129): rUK 2026/27 with no Personal Allowance above 125,140, tax(T) = 0.45T - 13,797; the Lump Sum Allowance 268,275 (GOV.UK, Tax when you get a pension) caps the tax-free part; net = 0.55W + 134,520.75 = 900,000 gives W = 1,391,780 and taxable 1,123,505.

No frozen outside answer: the personal inflation rate is computed from ONS MM23 division rates that refresh each weekday, so any pinned figure goes stale within a month. This case proves the widget computes and renders a rate for the default household profile. The figures are checked at deploy by RCOL-PHP-001 against an independent model (D114).

not_covered.reason: I387 (2026-10-22): the results come from a web worker that runs the plan over 121 UK start years; test_drawdown_bt.js (every push) checks the worker and the page against the independent Python oracle, the page's default form included. A live-check entry with fixed inputs is an INBOX item.
